discription: Simple FM synthesis with a pulsing envelope, suitable for percussive or short melodic sounds.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, carrierFreqRatio=1, modFreqRatio=1, modIndex=10;    var sig, mod;    var env = EnvGen.ar(        Env.adsr(0.005, 0.05, 0.5, 0.5, curve: -4),        gate: gate,        doneAction: 2    );    mod = SinOsc.ar(freq * modFreqRatio) * (freq * modFreqRatio * modIndex);    sig = SinOsc.ar(freq * carrierFreqRatio + mod) * amp * env;    Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
